title: Is the shop open?

blocks.text: Opening hours are `LocalTime` values: a time of day with no date and no zone. A `LocalTime` only runs from `00:00` (`LocalTime.MIDNIGHT`) to `23:59:59.999999999` (`LocalTime.MAX`), so a window that closes after midnight has a closing time that is *earlier* than its opening time.

Write `OpeningHours.isOpen(LocalTime time, LocalTime open, LocalTime close)`. It returns whether `time` is within the window from `open` to `close`, both ends included. When `close` is before `open`, the window runs overnight, from `open` through midnight to `close`. When `open` equals `close`, the window is that single moment, not the whole day.

cases.says: A time inside a daytime window is open, and a time before or after it is closed.
The opening time and the closing time themselves are open.
A 22:00 to 06:00 window is open late at night and early in the morning, and closed at noon.

concepts: A LocalTime runs from midnight to LocalTime.MAX, so a window past midnight has its close before its open.
